reviews.title: Lovely people behind Momo and experience is comforting!
reviews.text:
I'm a huge fan of the way Momo is set up and looks, and it's very clear a lot of love and care was put into the creation of this app. It's visually appealing and I love how they made Momo this gentle character. As someone who's always very sleepy, prefers dim lighting, loves purple and is very laid back, I strongly vibe with the theme of the app as a whole.

Most similar apps also feel thrown together with less thought behind it, but it feels like there's genuine effort put into Momo and providing something for those in need of something gamified like this. My brain never worked with the standard task-manager and I always found more motivation and joy in feeling like I'm not alone in whatever my habits/tasks are. I appreciate Momo for being a safe space for me and that I came across this app by pure chance on my hunt for something exactly like this.

Thank you to the people behind Momo and I can't wait to see how the app will continue to develop ❤️
